answer: Random dawn pings with summit review block duplicate aliases. A new alias must answer unannounced dawn pings within 5 minutes on 12 separate days, and each ping asks for fresh proof tied to that day's assigned work. One operator running many aliases cannot answer every ping in time, and matching response delays across aliases flag the copies for review at a weekly summit by three reviewers who never graded their own work. A confirmed copy pays a 20 percent fine from its next epoch earnings, sits out 12 epochs, and loses its violet badge, so it cannot slip back in under a new name.
